title: Disguised complex balance via positive algebraic geometry
summary: We study dynamical systems arising from reaction networks under mass-action kinetics. For certain choices of the rate constants (parameters), such systems are complex-balanced (vertex-balanced), which guarantees the existence of a unique positive equilibrium. Moreover, this equilibrium is asymptotically stable (admitting a global Lyapunov function) and linearly stable.
